messages:
Ryan (AE): Heads-up team — CardioAI POC is moving to contracting. Legal pushed back on DPA liability + subprocessors, procurement has Coupa integration questions and wants signer names. Need a fast, minimal path to signature so they can issue PO.

Pri (SE): Security asked for SAML SSO and SOC2; BYOK only for Private — CardioAI is fine with managed keys for initial deployment. Confirm we add BYOK-note to OF for future SOW.

Claire (Legal): DPA redline summary: (1) they want a 30-day data export window, (2) right to prior subprocessor approval, (3) liability cap = 1x fees. We can accept (1) and (2) if we tighten security attestations; cap at 1x fees requires legal lead approval. I'll prepare a clean counter and flag exec if they won't budge.

Malik (Procurement): For PO via Coupa we need: legal entity name, VAT/EIN, remit address, PO number, two authorized signers, and if possible the Coupa supplier ID/endpoint. They also prefer DocuSign and customer to sign first. Who's collecting signers?

Ryan (AE): I'll get signer names. Initial billing block I'm proposing to include in the order form:

```
Order Form
Customer: CardioAI, Inc.
Billing contact: ap@cardioai.com
Remit address: 500 Heart St, Suite 300, Boston, MA 02110
Tax ID: EIN 11-2233445
Term: 12 months
Commit: $85,000 / month
Billing terms: Net30
One-time onboarding credit: $4,000 applied to invoice #1 upon milestone completion
Signers: Tara Bennett (CFO), Leo Martinez (Head Procurement)
Notes: BYOK available for Private deployments per separate SOW; not in scope for initial POC
```

Jo (Finance): Net30 OK. Please cc finance-billing@redwood.com for PO routing. If they require PO-matching, ask for GL code mapping. If Coupa's automated invoice will be used, we need their supplier ID and invoice schema.

Claire (Legal): Add electronic signature clause: "Execution by electronic signature (e.g., DocuSign) constitutes an original signature." Also add a short fallback: "If liability cap deviation is requested, Redwood will escalate to Legal Lead (emma_r) and Finance for approval."

Malik (Procurement): Sequencing preference: CardioAI prefers to sign Order Form + DPA first, then Redwood countersigns, then CardioAI issues PO referencing signed documents. If their internal process requires PO before signing we can accept but it may delay invoicing.

Pri (SE): Also note: security will attach SOC2 report and SAML config guide. ops-privacy-bot, can you attach SOC2?

ops-privacy-bot: SOC2 report uploaded: https://redwood.internal/reports/soc2-2026-cardioai

Ryan (AE): Final checklist before I send redline: (1) updated OF with billing + onboarding credit + BYOK note, (2) Claire's redlined DPA counter, (3) DocuSign flow: customer signs then Redwood countersigns, (4) include Coupa supplier ID if they have it, (5) cc finance-billing@redwood.com and ops-privacy@redwood.com. Anything else?

Claire (Legal): That's good. If CardioAI insists on 1x liability cap, I'll escalate. Otherwise send the counter and request signer confirmation.

Jo (Finance): Add line for remittance email and request anticipated PO number once available. Also flag AR team for any delayed PO scenarios.

Ryan (AE): Great — I'll collect signers and Coupa info, send the OF + DPA counter today, and post responses here. :thumbsup:
